newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan lifts restrictions on CATV foreign ownership.
newsitem.headline: Japan lifts restrictions on CATV foreign ownership.

text.p: Japan's Posts and Telecommunications Ministry said on Tuesday that it had decided this week to scrap its restrictions on foreign ownership in cable television (CATV) companies.
Under the current Telecommunications Business Law, foreigners are banned from owning over one-third of a CATV firm.
But this law is expected to be revised in the current ordinary session of the Japanese parliament, a ministry official said.
Analysts said once freed, foreign companies are likely to enter new businesses, such as providing Internet and telephone services, which are currently being explored by CATV firms.
In a related development, the ministry said early last year that it intends to deregulate restrictions on foreign ownership in telecommunications carriers.
